newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell new 2009 TEC 10 OAT on March 6.
newsitem.headline: France to sell new 2009 TEC 10 OAT on March 6.

text.p: France plans to sell between eight and 10 billion francs ($1.8 billion) of a new January 25 2009 variable rate OAT based on the TEC 10 index for the first time at its next OAT auction on March 6, the Treasury said in a statement.
Like the existing October 2006 TEC 10 OAT, the coupon will be paid quarterly and will be 100 basis points below the TEC 10 index which is based on current 10-year benchmark OAT yields.
The payment date will be March 25.
The announcement was expected following a meeting between primary dealers and the Treasury on Tuesday evening.
